meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会进入“超工作”模式，严格按指令执行编码任务：先创建目标与验收标准，再逐步实现并验证，最后提供证据。
howto.when: 当用户输入中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”关键词时触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，帮我修复这个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会启动超工作流程，先创建目标再修复。

say.text: ulw 模式，写一个用户注册接口。
say.note: Claude 会按超工作规范逐步实现并验证。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude enters 'ultrawork' mode: it creates a goal with success criteria, then iterates through pin-red-green-surface-clean loops until all criteria pass with evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user's prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and help me fix this bug.
say_en.note: Claude will start the ultrawork workflow, first creating a goal then fixing.

say_en.text: ulw mode, write a user registration endpoint.
say_en.note: Claude will follow ultrawork rules to implement and verify step by step.
